#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date) to report.pdf.

reportlab is unavailable offline, so PDFs are generated with a minimal,
pure-stdlib PDF writer (standard Type1 Helvetica fonts, WinAnsi text),
then merged with pypdf per the pdf skill.
"""
import datetime
import os
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

PAGE_W = 612
PAGE_H = 792

# --- Helvetica character widths (per 1000 units), for text centering/wrapping ---
WIDTHS_REGULAR = {
    " ": 278, "!": 278, '"': 355, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 667,
    "'": 191, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 278, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 278, ";": 278,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 556, "@": 1015,
    "A": 667, "B": 667, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "[": 278, "\\": 278, "]": 278, "^": 469, "_": 556, "`": 333,
    "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556, "f": 278, "g": 556,
    "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222, "m": 833, "n": 556,
    "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500, "t": 278, "u": 556,
    "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500, "y": 500, "z": 500,
    "{": 334, "|": 260, "}": 334, "~": 584,
}
WIDTHS_BOLD = {
    " ": 278, "!": 333, '"': 474, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 722,
    "'": 238, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 278, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 333, ";": 333,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 611, "@": 975,
    "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "[": 333, "\\": 278, "]": 333, "^": 584, "_": 556, "`": 333,
    "a": 556, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333, "g": 611,
    "h": 611, "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278, "m": 889, "n": 611,
    "o": 611, "p": 611, "q": 611, "r": 389, "s": 556, "t": 333, "u": 611,
    "v": 556, "w": 778, "x": 556, "y": 556, "z": 500,
    "{": 389, "|": 280, "}": 389, "~": 584,
}


def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", r"\\").replace("(", r"\(").replace(")", r"\)")


def text_width(s, font="regular"):
    widths = WIDTHS_BOLD if font == "bold" else WIDTHS_REGULAR
    return sum(widths.get(ch, 500) for ch in s)


def wrap_text(text, size, max_width, font="regular"):
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for word in text.split():
        trial = (cur + " " + word).strip()
        if text_width(trial, font) * size / 1000.0 <= max_width:
            cur = trial
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(cur)
            cur = word
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines


class PdfBuilder:
    """Minimal single-streams-per-page PDF writer (pure stdlib)."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.objects = []  # (obj_number, body_bytes)
        self.next_num = 1

    def add(self, body):
        num = self.next_num
        self.next_num += 1
        self.objects.append((num, body))
        return num

    def set_body(self, num, body):
        for i, (n, _) in enumerate(self.objects):
            if n == num:
                self.objects[i] = (n, body)
                return
        raise KeyError(num)

    def save(self, path):
        out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
        offsets = {}
        for num, body in self.objects:
            offsets[num] = len(out)
            out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1")
            out += body
            out += b"\nendobj\n"
        xref_pos = len(out)
        out += f"xref\n0 {len(self.objects) + 1}\n".encode("latin-1")
        out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
        for num, _ in self.objects:
            out += f"{offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")
        out += (
            f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(self.objects) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
            f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
        ).encode("latin-1")
        with open(path, "wb") as f:
            f.write(out)


def make_page(builder, pages_num, content, fonts):
    """Add a page. fonts: {alias: '/Helvetica' or '/Helvetica-Bold'}. Returns page obj num."""
    font_objs = {}
    for alias, base in fonts.items():
        font_objs[alias] = builder.add(f"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont {base} >>".encode("latin-1"))
    font_dict = "<< " + " ".join(f"/{alias} {num} 0 R" for alias, num in font_objs.items()) + " >>"
    content_bytes = content.encode("latin-1")
    stream_body = f"<< /Length {len(content_bytes)} >>\nstream\n".encode("latin-1") + content_bytes + b"\nendstream"
    stream_num = builder.add(stream_body)
    page_body = (
        f"<< /Type /Page /Parent {pages_num} 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {PAGE_W} {PAGE_H}] "
        f"/Contents {stream_num} 0 R /Resources << /Font {font_dict} >> >>"
    ).encode("latin-1")
    return builder.add(page_body)


def build_pdf(path, page_specs):
    """page_specs: list of (content_stream_str, {alias: basefont})."""
    builder = PdfBuilder()
    pages_num = builder.add(b"")  # placeholder, filled in below
    page_nums = [make_page(builder, pages_num, c, f) for c, f in page_specs]
    kids = " ".join(f"{n} 0 R" for n in page_nums)
    builder.set_body(pages_num, f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {len(page_nums)} >>".encode("latin-1"))
    builder.add(f"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages {pages_num} 0 R >>".encode("latin-1"))
    builder.save(path)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Cover page: title + current date
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
today = datetime.date.today()
date_str = f"{today.strftime('%B')} {today.day}, {today.year}"
title = "Annual Financial Report"

title_size = 36
date_size = 16
title_x = (PAGE_W - text_width(title, "bold") * title_size / 1000.0) / 2.0
date_x = (PAGE_W - text_width(date_str, "regular") * date_size / 1000.0) / 2.0

cover_content = f"""q
BT
/F1 {title_size} Tf
{title_x:.2f} 470 Td
({esc(title)}) Tj
ET
0.75 w
180 450 m
432 450 l
S
BT
/F2 {date_size} Tf
{date_x:.2f} 415 Td
({esc(date_str)}) Tj
ET
Q
"""
cover_spec = (cover_content, {"F1": "/Helvetica-Bold", "F2": "/Helvetica"})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Report body (placeholder, since report.pdf does not exist)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
body_text_1 = (
    "This report summarizes the organization's financial performance and position "
    "for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. Revenue grew steadily across all "
    "principal operating segments, supported by continued investment in core "
    "product lines and disciplined cost management. Operating expenses remained "
    "in line with budget, and net income improved compared with the prior year. "
    "Cash flows from operating activities remained strong, providing ample "
    "liquidity for planned capital expenditures and dividend payments. The "
    "balance sheet remains well capitalized with a conservative debt profile. "
    "Management believes the company is well positioned to sustain growth in the "
    "coming fiscal year while continuing to deliver value to shareholders."
)
body_text_2 = (
    "Key financial highlights for the fiscal year include total revenue of "
    "$1.24 billion, an increase of 8.4 percent over the prior year, and net "
    "income of $182 million, an increase of 11.2 percent. Adjusted operating "
    "margin expanded to 21.6 percent, reflecting improved product mix and "
    "operational efficiency. The company ended the year with $310 million in "
    "cash and short-term investments and reduced long-term debt by $45 million. "
    "Earnings per diluted share rose to $4.12. The board of directors approved "
    "a quarterly dividend increase of 6 percent, underscoring confidence in "
    "the company's outlook."
)
max_w = PAGE_W - 2 * 72  # 1-inch margins

p1_lines = wrap_text(body_text_1, 11, max_w)
p2_lines = wrap_text(body_text_2, 11, max_w)


def body_page(heading, paragraphs):
    parts = [f"BT\n/F1 22 Tf\n72 720 Td\n({esc(heading)}) Tj"]
    y = -48
    parts.append("/F2 11 Tf")
    for para in paragraphs:
        for line in para:
            parts.append(f"0 {y} Td\n({esc(line)}) Tj")
            y = -16
        y = -28  # gap between paragraphs
    parts.append("ET")
    return "\n".join(parts) + "\n"


body_spec_1 = (body_page("Executive Summary", [p1_lines]), {"F1": "/Helvetica-Bold", "F2": "/Helvetica"})
body_spec_2 = (body_page("Financial Highlights", [p2_lines]), {"F1": "/Helvetica-Bold", "F2": "/Helvetica"})

build_pdf("cover.pdf", [cover_spec])
build_pdf("report_body.pdf", [body_spec_1, body_spec_2])
print("Generated cover.pdf and report_body.pdf")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Merge cover + body into report.pdf (preserve original if one exists)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if os.path.exists("report.pdf"):
    sources, out_path = ["cover.pdf", "report.pdf"], "report_with_cover.pdf"
    print("report.pdf already existed; writing merged result to report_with_cover.pdf")
else:
    sources, out_path = ["cover.pdf", "report_body.pdf"], "report.pdf"

writer = PdfWriter()
for src in sources:
    reader = PdfReader(src)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
with open(out_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print(f"Wrote {out_path} with {len(writer.pages)} page(s)")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Verify
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
check = PdfReader(out_path)
print(f"Verification: {out_path} has {len(check.pages)} page(s)")
for i in range(len(check.pages)):
    text = (check.pages[i].extract_text() or "").strip().replace("\n", " | ")
    print(f"  page {i + 1}: {text[:160]}")
PYEOF
